content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides information on premixed insulin products, including Aspart 70/30 and Lispro 50/50 or 75/25. The Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for these products ranges from $180 to $342, while the National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) ranges from $145 to $274. For NPH/regular 70/30 insulin, the AWP falls between $172 and $208, and the NADAC ranges from $132 to $303.
